chapter: The Legends of Jazz and life on the road
title: The first Legends tour and recording in Minneapolis
summary: The band rehearses and tours from Chicago through a Wisconsin ski lodge to Minneapolis, where they make their first record.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: You say Barry more or less rediscovered you when you were playing on that engagement out in Orange County; is it?
That's right.
And asked you to join him.
That's right.
How long was it before the band became organized after your initial contact with him?

Well we started rehearsing a couple of months later; this was near the holidays of '72, around December, and we started rehearsing the next year, around February or March, around in there. We rehearsed up to our next tour
which was in September. I can remember we were supposed to go to Europe with this tour, but Europe was cancelled so we just made this trip.
You went up to New England; is that right?

Our first stop was a ski lodge in Wisconsin; Kaybee, Wisconsin, a ski lodge. We played there a few days and then we went to Minneapolis and played a club there called the Emporium of Jazz. Mendota, Minnesota.
Were there any significant incidents or anything unusual about these first engagements?

Well, the first engagement the only incident was we travelled by car from Chicago to Kaybee, Wisconsin and we had to stop overnight; we couldn't make it all in one day, so we stopped at some town in Wisconsin, right near Madison. It was cold but it wasn't
snowing so we parked our car right outside the motel and the next morning when we woke up we couldn't see the car because it was all covered with snow. This was February; can you imagine.

Anyway, we made it from there to the ski lodge in Kaybee and we played there, I think, three days. Then we drove from there to Minneapolis where we had about a week. This was right outside Minneapolis called Mendota, called the Jazz Emporium.
We played there two days and then we had a recording, our first recording with this band, in Minneapolis.
That was the first recording that you made with the Legends?
Yes.
It was made where?
In Minneapolis, Minnesota.
Then we left there and went to
Grand Rapids, Michigan where we played two nights.
Is that record obtainable?
Yes, we have it; but not in the stores. He sells it at concerts.
I see. Special mail order?
You could get it that way; yes.
What's the label?
I'll have to think.
All right. Go right on, Mr. Blakeney.
